The decision the card says a fix would need (「whether ③ gains a second exception at all」) is already made in SKILL.md, so nothing goes to the decision box. Graded 2026-09-16T09:34Z: **p3 · Task · `pm:queue` · `domain:skills`** — direction: one in-place re-key of the ③ row (60 / 60, ≤120 B, pay by deletion inside the row) that names the SKILL.md three-condition clause as ③'s second exception by pointer, ⛔ not by restating the three conditions (single home stays SKILL.md + core-rules); ⛔ ③'s 「非 required 子集」 discipline and the merge-base exception are not weakened. References tier: default judgment tier build, in-seat review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, in-seat landing. Dedup over this lane's 99 most recently updated cards, open and closed, by `by-design` / `按设计` / `carve-out` / `check-empty-changeset` (control `contract-review` → 11 hits): this card only — no duplicate. Serial: BEHIND #18382 (IN FLIGHT, wave 4, same file, the :37 row) — the successor merges `origin/main`; the two rows are eight lines apart, so a fold is not owed (gate ① fails: a scope statement vs a missing pointer).
